speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation, yellowing of your skin and eyes, and abnormal lab findings. To understand the cause of your jaundice, have you noticed any fever, abdominal pain, or changes in your urine or stool color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely viral or toxic due to substance use).

Based on your history of high-risk sexual behavior, substance use, and the rapid onset of jaundice and agitation, I need to confirm the cause. Did you have any recent unprotected sexual contact, and have you experienced nausea, vomiting, or dark urine in the last few days? I will also need to see your specific liver function test results.
